scenario_description:
Objective: Turn a gear-labeling booth at packet pickup into a small convenience for an existing PFD dry bag.
Emerging Need: Early notices only suggest the booth; later updates confirm compatible materials, exact submission fields, and a short print batch.
Decision Context: A gear-care record is needed to identify the qualifying bag and its preselected label details rather than guessing from the booth notices.
Consequence: Timely coordination could add a durable free label; doing nothing leaves the bag and pickup plan unchanged once the batch list closes.

parameter.title: Rainwake packet pickup and open dock
parameter.description: Pick up winter race packet, confirm boat staging notes, and check vendor tables.

parameter.subject: Packet pickup vendor table notes
parameter.body: The January 21 packet table may include a local wrap vendor testing a small heat-press station for free personal gear labels. The station is not taking names yet; material compatibility and the intake sheet are expected tomorrow if the test patches hold.

parameter.content: Dock update: the label press passed its table check, and the vendor is bringing white and silver film. They are still deciding which soft goods count, so they asked us not to send label details until the intake sheet is posted.

parameter.subject: Free packet-pickup label batch: intake fields
parameter.body: For the Rainwake packet pickup, Harbor Wraps can print one free removable label per paddler for personal soft gear. Compatible items include matte nylon PFD dry bags and deck pouches. Intake closes today at 4:30 PM: send item type, item color/material, preferred film color, and label text up to 12 characters to harborwraps@vendors.example. The cut list will be locked at 4:35 PM for Wednesday pickup.

parameter.content: Harbor Wraps just told the dock volunteers the 4:35 label batch is locked and the cutter is running. They will hand out finished labels Wednesday, but they are not adding more names at packet pickup.
